title: Two calendars, one room — how a double booking actually happens
styleLine: ONE CONSISTENT LINE ACROSS ALL IMAGES (critical). Cinematic editorial photography, shot as if by the SAME photographer on the SAME 35mm lens, same warm natural grade — deep navy shadows (#262B38) + warm cream light (#F7F8EA), rich but natural (NOT a heavy Instagram filter, NOT washed-out, NOT HDR). Modern boutique-hotel world: walnut wood, cream plaster, greenery, contemporary fixtures. NO dated props (no key racks, service bells, fountain pens, paper ledgers, cash). Elegant, quiet, expensive. 4:5 (1080x1350). No text, no logos, no clearly identifiable faces.
note: Path B · EDUCATIONAL. Teaches the mechanism behind overbooking: sync direction. Slide 4 is a DEVICE-COMPOSITE (laptop, blank white screen) carrying the channel view. No claims, no guarantees — the lesson is engineering fact plus one question the reader can go and ask.

slides.imagePrompt: A boutique hotel room perfectly made up and ready for a guest: crisp white linen, walnut headboard, cream plaster, a small plant, soft morning light through sheer curtains. Completely empty and still. The main subject must sit in the UPPER ~55-60% of the frame, leaving a clean, uncluttered, darker LOWER ~40% for text. Deliver ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS PHOTOGRAPH natively in 4:5 (1080x1350). Do NOT letterbox, pad, extend or outpaint — no horizontal seam anywhere; the empty lower area must be part of the photographed scene (a real table top, floor or wall in shadow). slides.title: Your system knows. ==The OTA doesn't.==
slides.body: A guest books on your site. Your PMS marks the night sold. If the sync only runs one way, Booking.com is still selling it.

slides.title: The gap is measured in __minutes__.
slides.body: Channel managers push on a cycle, not instantly. The overlap window is small. It only has to catch you once.

slides.imagePrompt: DEVICE-COMPOSITE SLIDE — read carefully. The laptop must be PERFECTLY STRAIGHT AND FRONT-ON: screen plane exactly parallel to the camera, ZERO rotation, ZERO tilt, no perspective, edges square to the frame. Its screen must be a COMPLETELY BLANK PURE-WHITE rectangle (#FFFFFF) — no UI, no text, no reflections, no glare, nothing overlapping it, all four corners fully visible with a little clearance. slides.body: Your direct booking closes that night on every channel, and their booking lands in your system. One source of truth.
